title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 3: First Blood

scenes.say: Iraq. The heat hits like a wall the second the ramp drops.
scenes.visual: the ramp of a military cargo plane opening onto blinding desert light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali's unit rolls out at night. Convoy. Lights off.
scenes.visual: a line of armored vehicles moving through the desert at night, dust under moonlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Next to him rides Roddy. Country boy. Laughs at everything.
scenes.visual: two soldiers in helmets inside a vehicle, one laughing, faces in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy calls him Newark. Ali calls him Hillbilly. Brothers anyway.
scenes.visual: two soldiers bumping fists inside an armored truck, red interior light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Then the radio crackles. Contact. Left side.
scenes.visual: a military radio handset close up, glowing dials in the dark, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Muzzle flashes light up the dark like a block party gone wrong.
scenes.visual: distant muzzle flashes across a dark desert ridge, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali's hands shake. Then they don't.
scenes.visual: close up of gloved hands steadying on a rifle stock, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Everything the street taught him about fear, he uses now.
scenes.visual: a soldier crouched behind a concrete barrier, smoke drifting, night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: When it's quiet again, nobody talks. Everybody breathes.
scenes.visual: soldiers sitting silently against a wall at dawn, helmets off, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy grins at him. Told you we'd make it, Newark.
scenes.visual: sunrise over a desert outpost, two soldiers sitting side by side, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Four. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: dog tags hanging from a rearview mirror, desert sunrise outside, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 3 of 25: First Blood. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
